statement: For every toroidal output, central Euler=11k+t4, pi1=Z and H1=Z; the nearby Euler function is the branch multiplicity at one-branch points and0 at multiple-branch points, integrating to2.
notes: Includes nonreduced centres; k is the pure-top orbit count and t4 the fundamental-prism maximal-cone count. Higher integral homology is determined separately in A.4.8.
